concepts.title: How it works
concepts.attachments: Attachments upload to your knowledge library first; the message references them as @doc: — answers ground in document content, not just model memory.
concepts.knowledge: The Knowledge page manages your document collection; files attached in chat land in the same collection.
concepts.sessions: Sessions are stored in the local database; switch from the sidebar list, bookmark via URL (/chat/<id>).
concepts.tools: Tool blocks show the agent's actual calls: blue = running, green = done, red = failed; click to expand input and output.
